name: IDEMO - Serbia Concierge & Planner
description:
Ultra-compact, minimalistic premium concierge planner for EXPO 2027 visitors exploring the offbeat wonders of Serbia.

## How IDEMO Works

IDEMO is a private travel concierge designed to help you make the most of your time in Serbia.

### Configure Once

Set your available time, budget, interests and language in Profile.

IDEMO continuously adapts recommendations to these preferences, eliminating the need for repetitive searching and filtering.

### Discover Effortlessly

Browse carefully curated experiences matched to your schedule, interests and location.

Each recommendation includes practical planning information such as duration, travel time, estimated cost and local insights.

### Private by Design

No registration is required.

Your preferences and saved experiences remain stored locally on your device.

### Travel Pass

Use your Travel Pass to transfer preferences and saved experiences between devices without creating an account.

### Human Assistance

Need additional guidance?

Ask IDEMO about any experience directly from within the app.

Responses are typically provided within a few hours.
